verdict.rationale: The docs show some user control over where data lives and what is shared. Diagnostic logs stay in the app until the user chooses Send feedback (docs-18), sharing of extra usage data is an opt-in toggle (docs-16), cloud backup is a user-controlled toggle with a chosen account (docs-13), and passwords can be exported (docs-10). However, nothing documents user-initiated deletion of stored data, backups, or Microsoft-side records, or any retention settings. The community reports of data being wiped by an app update (comm-1) and of a vendor-scheduled password wipe (comm-11) describe deletion outside the user's control. missing for 10: documented deletion of cloud backups and server-side data, configurable retention periods, account or data deletion workflow, independent corroboration of the privacy controls.
